title: Malicious code in taskquay (PyPI)
description: The taskquay package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign involving loader packages that download and execute remote malicious scripts. While the packages themselves do not contain the payload, their coordinated use facilitates executing harmful code from external sources. This campaign is identified as having clear malicious intent, such as infostealing.
aiSummary: This threat involves the taskquay package version 0.1.0 on PyPI, which is part of a broader campaign distributing loader packages designed to execute code fetched from remote URLs. These packages do not embed malicious payloads directly but serve as mechanisms to load and run malicious scripts remotely. The campaign is coordinated and aims to provide multiple deceptive methods for loading malicious code, indicating a deliberate effort to facilitate malicious activities like information theft.
aiImpact: The impact stems from the package's capability to download and execute remote malicious scripts, potentially leading to unauthorized code execution and information theft on systems where the package is installed. Since the malicious payload is executed remotely, the actual impact depends on the content of the downloaded scripts, which may vary. There are no known exploits in the wild at this time.
